about: Second refresh of 2026-11-14 (late afternoon): the shape of a periodic face (GPU pull request 16, CLAIMS GP9) and twisted faces at equal area (CLAIMS SH1, SH2; research/shape/README.md; research/audit/REVIEW-shape.md). Each item: value (numbers drawn on the page), quote (copied from research/NOTEBOOK.md or research/CLAIMS.md; collect.py checks that it occurs there and that each value occurs in it), src.

cpu72.quote: The reviewer's CPU run (a different stepper, checked against the engine on both slabs, channels resolved) gives −0.344 ± 0.020 for the pair at 72 cells.

families.src: NB 2026-11-14, equal areas, different lifetimes (table: slope within each family of short side s)

mixed.quote: Fitted with area alone, the slabs with s ≥ 4 give 0.2085 per cell (and a hopeless χ² of 512 on 10), above every family's own slope, because wider slabs were also the larger ones. The 0.2088 of the CPU table (CLAIMS F4, A = 27–90, mixed widths) is a slope of that kind.

wide.quote: The cost per cell of a wide periodic face** is 0.2072 if the width enters as an offset and 0.2117 if the long side does; b(6) = 0.213 ± 0.006 allows both.
wide.src: NB 2026-11-14, equal areas, different lifetimes [open]; CLAIMS GP9 (not decided)

decide.quote: Deciding needs b(5) to about ± 0.0003 (some 2,500 face deaths at 5×8×8, where there are 189), or a seventh width, each about fifty times the cost of the last.

agree.quote: Different shapes with the same shortest loop agree: χ² = 1.1 on 4 over distinct shapes (two at 9, two at 12, three at 16).

control.quote: The control passed: the twist k = 2 of 4×6 is the same torus as 4×6 under the automaton's symmetries and the flip of the slab, and gives 14.974 against 14.968.

pair60.quote: At 60 cells two different tori with the same shortest loop (squared 16) differ: 4×5 gives 12.490 ± 0.003 and (5,1),(0,4) gives 12.471 ± 0.003 (0.019 ± 0.004).

size.quote: At 72 cells the rise is about 0.15 per unit of loop length between 3.46 and 4.58 (+0.075 ± 0.010 from 4 to 4.58, both runs pooled)

forecast.quote: the ordering held everywhere; "alone" failed at 60 cells; the sizes missed (+0.075 at loop² 21 where +0.04 was forecast; 14.877 and 14.921 at 12 and 13 where 14.78 and 14.83 were forecast).

wrap.quote: So every cost per cell measured on a periodic slab so far carries a wrap-around term, and the wide-face constant is not yet isolated from it.
